board.ground: Guild Floor (art/guild/Guild Floor.fbx, a decor entry below)
board.note: tile x 0..13 left->right, depth 0..9 front->back (Godot: position = Vector3(x, 0, -depth)). Same schema as the Camp's layout.json. The Mission Board is the centre piece AND the Missions station (centre.station); the other stations stand on a ring (ellipse) round it, every prop faces the camera (face_yaw 0). row: back = button above the prop, front = button below it. Floor and Hall are decor at the board centre, scale 1.

ring.note: slot k at angle 90 + k*360/5 degrees (90 = straight behind the Mission Board, in the back wall line), counter-clockwise seen from above

centre.note: a station: the Missions button goes BELOW the board (row front) because the Guild Door stands right behind it on screen

slots.note: the Guild Door stands in the back wall line (its back face 0.36 tiles behind the slot, on the wall at depth 9.5)
